jobs.description:
We are looking for a production worker with a good knowledge of English. Are you handy and able to work with a pneumatic nail gun?

This company, located in Lokeren, is a growing family business specializing in the production, repair, and recycling of wooden pallets. To strengthen their team, we are looking for a motivated pallet repairer. Do you enjoy hands-on, repetitive work, and do you not shy away from physical labor? Then you might be the colleague the company is looking for. 

Your tasks:

• Assembling and repairing wooden pallets according to our quality standards.

• Working with a pneumatic nail gun.

• Sorting pallets by type and quality.

• Keeping your workspace clean, organized, and safe.

• Collaborating with your colleagues to meet daily production targets.

 

What we ask of you:

• You enjoy working with tools and like manual labor.

• You are physically fit and willing to work at a steady pace.

• You work accurately and have an eye for quality.

• You can express yourself in English; having another native language is no problem (but English is a must).

As an Import & Export Coordinator at Lotus Bakeries, you play a key role in ensuring the seamless flow of goods across international markets. You coordinate import and export shipments, manage customs processes, and work closely with logistics partners, internal stakeholders, and customs authorities.
 

As part of the Import & Export team you will:
 
 

• Coordinate and manage international import and export shipments across multiple transport modes (ocean, road, air, and multimodal), ensuring timely delivery while optimizing logistics flows to balance service, cost, and operational requirements. 

• Prepare and submit import and export customs declarations in-house or in collaboration with customs brokers, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable regulations. Manage communication with local customs authorities and internal compliance teams to facilitate efficient customs clearance and the timely resolution of customs-related issues. 

• Monitor transport performance and proactively resolve issues such as delays, demurrage, detention, and other operational disruptions. 

• Maintain accurate shipping and customs documentation and follow up on discrepancies or corrective actions when needed. 

• Ensure accurate data entry and management across logistics and customs systems, including master data maintenance and customs decision tables in CAS, while safeguarding data quality, integrity, and compliance. 

• Act as the key operational contact for shipment-related questions and escalations and support the implementation of new logistics and customs processes. 
 

• You have a Bachelor or Master degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Transport, Customs, or a related field. 

• A (first) experience with international freight flows and customs formalities has given you a good understanding of ocean, road, and air transport. 

• With your strong organizational and communication skills in both Dutch & English, you are able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining an accurate and detail-oriented approach. 

• Working independently comes naturally to you, while you also enjoy collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to achieve shared goals. 

• A proactive, hands-on, and customer-focused mindset helps you adapt to changing priorities and remain effective under pressure. 

• You are comfortable working with Microsoft Office, and experience with SAP S/4 or customs systems is considered a plus. 

• Your genuine interest in international supply chain, trade, and customs motivates you to continuously learn and develop in this field.

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Engineer Wafer Bonding & Assembly
jobs.description:
What you will do
 
 

• You take ownership of temporary wafer bonding and debonding processes and tools, leading process qualification, continuous improvement, problem prevention and the introduction of new processes. Your scope includes:  

• Temporary wafer bonding and debonding  

• Wafer level packaging: (WLUF lamination, molding, CUF dispense, TCB D2W bonding)  

• You lead cross-functional improvements and structured problem-solving across research, engineering and operations, working with technical experts and equipment and material suppliers to resolve complex process and equipment issues.  

• You lead discussions between R&D and Engineering teams to ensure that experiments involving new materials and substrates follow agreed guidelines, including risk assessment.  

• You own process control and documentation for your tools, including recipe management, statistical process control (SPC), procedures, technical escalations, upgrades and recovery flows.  

• You coach process engineers, share technical knowledge and strengthen the engineering capability of the Wafer Bonding & Assembly team.  

• You will work in day-shift. 

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Master’s degree in Science or Engineering, or have equivalent expertise gained through relevant experience.  

• You bring strong engineering judgement and an analytical approach, with demonstrated experience in process qualification, measurement, data interpretation and quality assurance.  

• You have at least 5 years of relevant experience in temporary wafer bonding and debonding and/or wafer level packaging including ownership of processes or tools and resolution of complex technical issues.  

• You work autonomously, prioritise technical challenges and deliver well-documented, lasting improvements with close attention to quality and detail.  

• You have demonstrated the ability to lead cross-disciplinary technical activities, align stakeholders and coach less experienced engineers.  

• You communicate fluently in English; additional languages are an asset.  

• You communicate technical findings, risks and recommendations clearly, and actively share knowledge to support colleagues and strengthen team expertise.

We are looking for an Audiovisual Event Logistics Technician to join our team in Brussels and provide hands-on logistical support for audiovisual and conference activities within an international institutional environment.

This role focuses on the preparation, transportation, installation support, and dismantling of audiovisual equipment used for conferences, meetings, and special events.

Your Role:

As an Audiovisual Event Logistics Technician, you will support the operational and logistical aspects of audiovisual events, working closely with AV technicians, coordinators, and event support teams.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Prepare, handle, transport, load, and unload audiovisual equipment and accessories.
• Assist with the installation and dismantling of temporary audiovisual and conference setups.
• Support technicians during event preparation, equipment installation, and removal.
• Prepare and organise cables, accessories, consumables, transport cases, and technical materials.
• Position equipment in meeting rooms, conference spaces, and event areas.
• Manage equipment storage, stock, inventory, and warehouse activities.
• Perform basic equipment inspections and report damaged, missing, or defective materials.
• Follow equipment lists, setup plans, packing instructions, and operational schedules.
• Ensure that equipment and working areas remain clean, safe, and properly organised.
• Support basic event equipment operations when required and under supervision. 
We are seeking a practical, organised, and reliable professional with experience in event logistics, audiovisual equipment handling, or technical event support.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

• Hands-on experience in event logistics, audiovisual equipment rental, or conference setup activities.
• Experience handling, transporting, installing, and dismantling technical equipment.
• Familiarity with temporary event setups, meeting rooms, or conference environments.
• Ability to follow operational instructions, equipment lists, and event schedules.
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Flexibility, teamwork, and the ability to work under time pressure.
• Good communication skills and a service-oriented attitude.
• Ability to perform physical tasks, including lifting equipment weighing at least 20 kg and climbing ladders with applicable safety rules and operational instructions.
Key Skills:

• Audiovisual Equipment: Basic knowledge of AV and conference systems used in meetings, events, and temporary installations.
• Event Logistics: Equipment preparation, transportation, loading, unloading, and dismantling.
• Warehouse & Inventory Management: Stock monitoring, storage organisation, equipment tracking, and inventory updates.
• Technical Support: Assistance with audiovisual installations and basic equipment operations under supervision.
• Digital Tools: Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook), Microsoft Teams, and inventory or planning tools.
• Safety Procedures: Understanding of safe equipment handling, lifting, transportation, and storage practices.
Desired Qualifications:

• Previous experience in audiovisual event logistics, equipment rental, event production, or technical logistics.
• Experience supporting AV technicians or event coordination teams.
• Familiarity with professional conference environments and audiovisual equipment.
• Experience working in international or multicultural environments.
• Languages: Fluent in either English or French, with a good working knowledge of the other language.
 
 
Joining CGIC means contributing to high-impact international projects in the IT and audiovisual sectors. You will work in a dynamic and multicultural environment, develop your expertise in professional audiovisual and conference technologies, and contribute to the smooth operation of critical meeting and conference services.

Your next professional opportunity starts here ¿ apply now!

jobs.description:

Your projects may relate to payments, credit or compliance for example.
Your tasks will be

• Follow up with technical analysts, designers and developers

• Describe test scenarios, prepare test data and coordinate test execution with the Test Coordinator

• Analyse results and propose corrective actions where needed

• Ensure consistency and quality of deliverables throughout the project lifecycle

• Dive into technical aspects when necessary

• Work closely with business teams to ensure the delivered solution meets their expectations

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have proven experience in Functional Analysis in the banking sector

• Very good knowledge of analysis tools and methodologies (UML, RUP, ARIS, Visio, Enterprise Architect, Jira, ...)

jobs.description:

This role will be really suited to someone who loves and excels the documentation aspect of the work, as well as the communication with stakeholders.
What will you be doing?

• Interviewing stakeholders to capture undocumented processes

• Producing and maintaining documentation

• Collecting and organizing process level execution, vulnerability scan and process reports

• Prepare materials to support internal audit, CCB self-assessment, and eventual certification readiness

• Using AI Tools as part of the production workflow

Logistics

• Hybrid working in Brussels

• Start ASAP

• 9 month contract

• Strong background within similar GRC and Information Security Roles

• French and English Speaking

• Demonstrated experience producing ISMS / compliance documentation (ISO 27001, NIS2, NIST/CyFun, or equivalent frameworks)

• Hands on profile

For one of our clients, a leading international player in the financial sector based in Brussels, Digitribe is looking for a senior Transformation Lead with a strong Lean and Continuous Improvement background. You will lead end-to-end transformation initiatives, help business teams rethink how they work, and make sure the change lasts.
Your role

• Lead complex transformation initiatives from scoping to delivery, with clear objectives, disciplined execution and measurable outcomes

• Apply Lean and continuous improvement methods (value stream mapping, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, process re-engineering) to redesign processes and services

• Structure complex cross-functional problems: diagnose root causes, challenge assumptions and align stakeholders on pragmatic target-state options

• Push business domains beyond incremental optimisation towards different ways of working where the value justifies it

• Define target operating models, covering roles and responsibilities, governance, controls, KPIs and management routines

• Identify automation and AI opportunities with IT, data and architecture teams, always tied to business value and adoption

• Embed risk, compliance, auditability and control requirements in a highly regulated environment from the start

• Build transformation roadmaps, transition states and business requirements, and drive benefit realisation through value hypotheses and KPIs

• Coach team members and business teams in Lean, problem-solving and facilitation so they can keep improving on their own

• Improve reusable methods, templates and playbooks to keep delivery consistent across initiatives

What makes you successful

You are comfortable with ambiguity and know how to bring structure and momentum to it. You are pragmatic and delivery-driven, empathetic, and you earn trust at every level. You lead from the front while empowering others, and you see yourself as a role model for continuous improvement.

• Master's degree or equivalent experience

• 10+ years of experience combining consulting with operational transformation or line-management roles

• Proven track record leading process re-engineering, service redesign or operating model transformation

• Strong hands-on Lean expertise and experience coaching others in it. Lean Six Sigma certification (Green/Black Belt) is a plus

• Familiarity with Agile principles

• Solid consulting toolkit: structured problem solving, hypothesis-driven analysis, workshop facilitation and executive communication

• Interest in AI, automation and data, with good judgment on feasibility, risk and adoption

• Experience in regulated, control-heavy environments. Financial services experience is a strong asset

• Excellent English (written and spoken). French and/or Dutch is a plus

Your RoleReporting directly to the HR Director, you will act as an all-round HR Generalist driving our "soft HR" strategy across the organization. You will take ownership of defined projects with clear milestones and deliverables to streamline HR operations and cultivate a healthy, open workplace culture.
Beyond initial design, your core focus will be the practical rollout, end-to-end implementation, and continuous follow-up of essential HR processes, ensuring that initiatives like onboarding, performance management, and learning & development don't just exist on paper, but are actively adopted, monitored, and sustained across all teams.
This is an ideal role for a pragmatic HR professional with the drive and capacity to step up into a senior HR leadership position as Fanfinity expands.
 
 

• End-to-end Recruitment: Together with colleagues in the HR team, independently manage a selected portfolio of vacancies: from crafting engaging role profiles, screening CVs, conducting interviews, and securing top talent to match our growth pace. 

• New Hire Onboarding: Take personal ownership of the soft landing for your newly placed hires running structured check-ins and follow-ups to ensure a smooth integration. 

• Performance Management: Roll out, manage, and actively follow up on the performance management cycle, guiding managers and employees through goal-setting, continuous feedback habits, structured performance reviews and guide team leads through yearly wage review cycle. 

• Learning & Development: Identify organizational skill gaps, design practical development pathways, coordinate targeted training initiatives, and follow up on employee growth plans to foster continuous internal upskilling. 

• Trusted Advisory: Act as an approachable, trusted partner for employees and managers alike, offering practical guidance on day-to-day people topics while embedding a company-wide culture of open feedback, mutual trust, and transparent communication. 

• Employee Engagement & Retention: Drive initiatives that boost team morale, monitor employee sentiment, and execute proactive retention strategies across our departments. 

What You BringMust-Have Requirements:
 
 

• Proven Experience: Minimum of 3 years of relevant HR generalist experience, with demonstrable hands-on experience in recruitment, performance management and/or learning & development. 

• Languages: Full professional fluency in both Dutch and English (spoken and written); comfortable interviewing candidates, advising leadership, drafting documentation, and holding sensitive discussions in both languages. 

• Implementation & Follow-Up Track Record: Proven ability to not just design HR workflows, but to roll them out, ensure manager and team adoption, and maintain systematic follow-up. 

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or equivalent practical experience. 

• Project Delivery: Demonstrated capability to manage defined HR projects independently and hit clear milestones and deliverables.  

Who You Are:
 
 

• Hands-On & Pragmatic: You enjoy rolling up your sleeves to implement solutions. 

• Proactive & Autonomous: You find it stimulating to spot an inefficient workflow, devise a structured fix, and drive it through to complete execution without micro-management. 

• Strong Communicator: You build trust quickly, navigate difficult conversations with empathy, and know how to rally managers around new HR initiatives. 

• Growth-Oriented: You bring intellectual curiosity, high emotional intelligence, and the leadership potential required to step into a senior HR role as the company scales.
